articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and mathematical proof generation, narrowing the gap with domain-specific formal verification tools. Enterprise API access began rolling out in late April with tiered rate limits.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind published results for Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which sets new records on GPQA Diamond, MATH-500, and a newly introduced molecular dynamics simulation benchmark. The model leverages a mixture-of-experts architecture with improved routing efficiency, reducing inference costs by roughly 40% compared to the previous generation. Google is integrating the model across Workspace and Google Cloud Vertex AI.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Fully Autonomous Warehouse Shift with Figure 03 Humanoids
articles.summary: Figure completed a 10-hour fully autonomous warehouse logistics demonstration using a fleet of eight Figure 03 humanoid robots at a BMW facility in South Carolina. The robots handled palletizing, bin picking, and inter-zone transport without human intervention, coordinated by a centralized task planner with onboard vision-language models for exception handling. The company announced commercial deployment contracts targeting Q3 2026.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Limited Production at Gigafactory Texas
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has entered low-rate initial production at Gigafactory Texas, with several hundred units planned for internal factory use by end of Q2. The new generation features 28 degrees of freedom in the hands, improved proprioceptive actuators, and an onboard inference chip running a distilled version of Tesla's FSD neural network adapted for manipulation. Elon Musk reiterated a target of external sales beginning in 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' Framework to Mitigate Agentic AI Risk
articles.summary: Anthropic published a detailed technical paper and open-source toolkit for Constitutional Classifiers, a runtime monitoring system designed to detect and intervene when agentic AI systems take actions that violate predefined safety constraints. The framework uses lightweight classifier heads attached at each tool-call boundary and was validated against a suite of 12,000 adversarial scenarios. The release is seen as a significant step toward industry-standard guardrails for autonomous AI agents.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production of its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at Fab 20 in Tainan, with first customer shipments expected in June 2026. The node delivers an 18% speed improvement or 30% power reduction over N2, leveraging backside power delivery and gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. Initial capacity is allocated primarily to NVIDIA and Apple for next-generation AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced that their trapped-ion quantum system achieved sustained logical error rates below 10⁻⁶ per logical gate operation across 12 logical qubits using real-time error correction. This milestone crosses a critical threshold needed for practical quantum algorithms and was demonstrated running a small instance of a lattice protein folding problem. The companies project scaling to 100+ logical qubits by 2028 using their modular architecture.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Electric with Construction-Grade Dexterity
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics showcased a major update to its electric Atlas platform, now equipped with reinforcement-learning-trained manipulation policies enabling it to operate power tools, carry irregular heavy loads, and navigate active construction sites. A pilot partnership with Hyundai Engineering & Construction has the robot performing rebar inspection and material transport on a high-rise project in Seoul. The company emphasized a new sim-to-real transfer pipeline that reduced manipulation policy training time from weeks to days.
